United Airlines Employee Threatens Customer with ICE Call

A United Airlines passenger was threatened by an employee who allegedly told the customer they did not 'act like a citizen' during a dispute over wait time at San Francisco International Airport. The incident has sparked concerns about racial profiling and the treatment of minority groups. The airline is investigating the matter.
